newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business
stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing.
Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Qiao Shi, chairman of the National People's Congress, visits Iran to promote bilateral relations.
The China Agricultural Development Bank is to issue 8.5 billion yuan in aid-the-poor loans in 1997.
A commentary says bankruptcy is a good way to improve economic efficiency by removing chronic loss-makers from the market and prompting other firms to make improvements.

The Ministry of Finance and the central bank are considering expansion of the scope of corporate bonds issues so as to absorb private domestic capital and boost investement in infrastructure projects.
China registered a trade surplus of $3.91 billion in October. Exports were up 23.3 percent from last October to $15.22 billion while imports rose three percent to $11.31 billion.
